product_overview: OpenPay is a Spanish-language fintech web app built with Next.js and Supabase that lets users register, authenticate, manage a digital wallet, send/receive money, pay services, and manage security and support. The app includes a dashboard, transaction history, service payments, and account settings.
core_goals: Provide secure email/password authentication and account registration via Supabase.
Give users a clear financial overview (balance, quick actions, recent transactions) on a responsive dashboard.
Enable peer-to-peer transfers and service payments with real-time validation and user feedback.
Expose full transaction history and per-transaction details with filtering and pagination.
Offer account security controls (password change, 2FA, biometrics) and user support channels.
Ensure protected routes require authentication and surface loading/error states for API operations.

features.name: User Authentication - Login
features.description: Allow existing users to authenticate with email and password using Supabase auth and redirect to the dashboard on success.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click "Iniciar sesión" (Login) button -> Be redirected to /dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field with invalid email -> Fill password input field -> Click "Iniciar sesión" (Login) button -> See error message on invalid credentials
Navigate to /login -> Click "Forgot password" link -> See password reset instructions or confirmation that reset email was sent

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Allow new users to create an account with full name, email, and password via Supabase signUp and then access the application.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill full name input -> Fill email input -> Fill password input -> Fill confirm password input -> Click "Crear cuenta" (Create Account) button -> Be redirected to /dashboard

Navigate to /register -> Fill full name input -> Fill email input -> Fill password input -> Fill confirm password input (mismatch) -> Click "Crear cuenta" (Create Account) button -> See validation errors about password confirmation

Navigate to /register -> Fill full name input -> Fill email input that already exists -> Fill password inputs -> Click "Crear cuenta" (Create Account) button -> See error message from server about duplicate account

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Main authenticated landing page showing account balance, quick actions (Send, Recargar), recent transactions, and a sidebar send-money form.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> See account balance displayed -> See recent transactions list -> Click "Enviar" (Send) quick action button -> Be taken to /dashboard/send
Navigate to /dashboard -> Click "Recargar" (Top-up) quick action button -> Be taken to /dashboard/receive
Navigate to /dashboard -> See account balance shows hardcoded value $12,520.35 (known limitation) -> See mixed mock and real transaction data

features.name: Transaction History
features.description: Provide a paginated list of all user transactions with filters and ability to view individual transaction details.
user_flows: Navigate to /transactions -> View paginated transaction list -> Filter transactions by type -> Click on individual transaction -> Be redirected to /transactions/[id] -> See transaction details
Navigate to /transactions -> See loading state while fetching transactions -> See error message if transactions fail to load

features.name: Service Payments
features.description: Let users pay utility services by selecting a provider, entering a reference/account number and amount, and processing payments via the /api/services/payment endpoint.
user_flows: Navigate to /services -> Click provider dropdown -> Select service provider from dropdown -> Enter account/reference number -> Enter payment amount -> Click "Pagar" (Pay) button -> Be redirected to /services/payment -> Be redirected to /services/payment-success on success

Navigate to /services -> Click provider dropdown -> See provider list loaded from /api/services/providers -> Enter account/reference number -> Enter invalid amount -> Click "Pagar" (Pay) button -> See payment error message
Navigate to /services -> Switch to Payment History tab -> See empty state for payment history (known limitation)

features.name: Security Settings
features.description: Allow users to manage password, two-factor authentication, and biometric settings from the security section.
user_flows: Navigate to /security -> Switch to Password tab -> Fill current password field -> Fill new password field -> Fill confirm new password field -> Click "Cambiar contraseña" (Change Password) button -> See success message
Navigate to /security -> Switch to Password tab -> Fill incorrect current password -> Click "Cambiar contraseña" (Change Password) button -> See validation/error message
Navigate to /security -> Switch to 2FA tab -> Toggle 2FA enable -> Follow setup steps -> See 2FA enabled confirmation

features.name: Customer Support
features.description: Provide a Support area with a contact form, FAQ, and resources to help users and collect support requests.
user_flows: Navigate to /support -> Switch to Contact tab -> Fill contact form subject -> Fill contact form message -> Submit contact form -> See success confirmation
Navigate to /support -> Submit contact form with empty required fields -> See validation errors
Navigate to /support -> Switch to FAQ tab -> Read FAQ items -> Click resource links in Resources tab

features.name: Send Money
features.description: Enable authenticated users to transfer funds to other OpenPay users by entering recipient email, amount, and an optional description.
user_flows: Navigate to /send-money -> Enter recipient email address -> Enter transfer amount -> Enter description/concept -> Click "Enviar dinero" (Send Money) button -> See success toast and transaction reflected in history
Navigate to /send-money -> Enter invalid recipient email -> Enter transfer amount -> Click "Enviar dinero" (Send Money) button -> See error message about invalid recipient
Navigate to /send-money -> Enter recipient email -> Enter transfer amount greater than available balance -> Click "Enviar dinero" (Send Money) button -> See insufficient funds error

features.name: Transfers
features.description: Manage past transfers and create new transfer requests from the transfers section.
user_flows: Navigate to /transfers -> View list of transfers -> Click create new transfer -> Be redirected to /transfers/new -> Fill transfer form -> Submit -> See new transfer in transfers list
Navigate to /transfers -> See empty state if no transfers exist

features.name: Contacts
features.description: Allow users to view and manage a list of frequent contacts for faster money transfers.
user_flows: Navigate to /contacts -> View contact list -> Click add new contact -> Fill contact name -> Fill contact email -> Save contact -> See new contact in the list
Navigate to /contacts -> Attempt to add contact with invalid email -> See validation error and contact not saved

features.name: Settings (Profile & Notifications)
features.description: Enable users to update profile information and notification preferences from the settings area.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Click Profile tab (/settings/profile) -> Update profile fields -> Save changes -> See success notification
Navigate to /settings -> Click Notifications tab (/settings/notifications) -> Toggle notification preferences -> Save -> See preferences persisted or confirmation
Navigate to /settings/profile -> Enter invalid profile data -> Click Save -> See validation errors

features.name: Verification
features.description: Collect identity verification documents and submit them for review to move users through verification steps.
user_flows: Navigate to /verification -> Upload official ID documents -> Submit verification request -> See pending status
Navigate to /verification -> Upload unsupported file type -> Attempt to submit -> See error message about file type or size

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: An administrative page exists to manage platform-level data; role-based access control may be incomplete and requires attention.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> See admin panel UI and controls (requires authenticated user) -> Perform admin actions if permitted
Navigate to /admin as a non-admin user -> See admin page accessible due to missing role checks (known limitation) -> Report unauthorized access risk
